_what: The author basis for pool records whose own registry record carries NO author field. The pool is the harvest's record of what the registry returned and is NOT edited here; this layer names, per key, the human author AND the real record the name was read from, so a reader can re-check the slot rather than trust it. An entry whose basis is 'not found' keeps an EMPTY author slot: an unverified name is never printed.
